statement: Let m >= 2 have Juggler orbit x_0 = m, x_{i+1} = J(x_i), parity word w, odd counts o_i and prefix ratios rho_i = 3^{o_i}/2^i. THE LOSS IDENTITY: the deficit d_i = rho_i ln m - ln x_i against the floor-free chain m^{rho_i} obeys d_{i+1} = p_i d_i + eta_i with p_i = rho_{i+1}/rho_i in {3/2, 1/2} and 0 <= eta_i < ln(1 + 1/x_{i+1}), because x_{i+1} <= x_i^{p_i} < x_{i+1} + 1; hence d_k <= rho_k sum_{j<=k} ln(1 + 1/x_j)/rho_j. THE DROP CRITERION: if rho_k > 1, no drop occurred before k, and x_k <= m - 1 (an uncertified drop), then S := sum_{j=1}^{k-1} 1/(rho_j x_j) >= (1 - 1/rho_k) ln m; proof: the j = k term is ln(x_k + 1) - ln x_k, move it left and use x_k + 1 <= m. THE CRUDE EXCURSION BOUND: x_j >= m for j < k and sum_{j<k} 1/rho_j < 2 O (each odd count o contributes a run of indices whose reciprocals 2^j/3^o sum below 2/rho at the run's last index, where rho > 1) give S < 2 O/m; k <= floor(O log2 3) gives rho_k >= 2^{f_O}, f_O = {O log2 3} >= delta(O) := min_{o <= O} ||o log2 3||. So an uncertified drop whose prefix has O odd letters needs 2 O/m > (1 - 2^{-delta(O)}) ln m: O >= 97 for m >= 10^4, 665 for 10^6, 16758 for 10^8, 190537 for 10^10; nondecreasing in m, and unbounded by Rhin's |O ln 3 - p ln 2| >= H^{-13.3}. THE REFINED EXCURSION BOUND: if moreover 2 O/m <= ln 2 (so S <= ln 2), then ln x_j = rho_j ln m - d_j >= rho_j (ln m - S) gives x_j >= (m/2)^{rho_j}, hence 1/(rho_j x_j) <= (2/m)^{rho_j}/rho_j; within the run of an odd count o these terms grow by a factor at least m/2 per step back from the run's last index, where rho >= 2^{f_o}, and the run of o = O has rho > 2, so S <= (1 + 2/m)(sum_{o<O} (2/m)^{2^{f_o}} + 2/m^2), and an uncertified drop needs this to exceed (1 - 2^{-f_O}) ln m. Both sides are monotone in m the right way, so a failure at m = M is a failure for all m >= M, and with f_o exact the admissible O at each M are a finite computation: the least is 16266 at 10^6, 31867 at 10^7, 111202 at 10^8, none below 300000 at 10^10; the admissible O sit at the dangerous denominators of log2 3 (3^q > 2^p: 12, 53, 665, 31867, 111202, 10590737, ...) plus multiples of 665. COMBINED WITH THE COMPUTATION (no uncertified drop for any odd m < 10^7, exact integers, every start past the digit cap run without it): every orbit whose excursion has fewer than 31867 odd letters drops exactly at its first contracting length. NOT PROVED: the equality for all m; a counterexample needs an excursion of that many odd letters ending at a dangerous denominator with the near-drop losses aligned, an accumulated shortfall of about 0.69 f_O m ln m units below the ideal where the measured shortfalls stay near a few units; nothing bounds the excursion, and this is the Juggler mirror of Terras's Conjecture 2.9. The proved direction, contracting prefix => drop, is power_bound_contracts in Envelope.lean (kernel).
